risk_description: Warranty reserve estimate potentially biased toward understatement — predecessor proposed a $2.1M increase in FY2024 that management declined to book.
Management override via manual journal entries — standard presumption, no override observed to date.
Sales incentive compensation structure (bonuses tied to bookings, uncapped credit-memo authority, target pressure from new CFO) creates fraud-triangle exposure around revenue timing.
Possible Q4 shipping-document backdating for one distributor (~$340,000) identified via internal audit cutoff follow-up; not yet substantiated.
Opening balance risk on the warranty reserve and retained earnings given the predecessor's unbooked proposed adjustment.
